AnalyzeForm.title: Multicriteria Analysis
AnalyzeForm.description: Fill in the details below to run the analysis.
AnalyzeForm.criteriasDesc: Select and adjust the relative importance of each criterion for decision making. The assigned weight (1 to 10) will be automatically normalized so that the total sum equals 100%.
AnalyzeForm.criteriaSumError: The sum of the criteria values must be less than or equal to 1
AnalyzeForm.thresholdsDesc: Adjust the comparison parameters used by the multicriteria method. The Indifference threshold defines the limit to consider alternatives equivalent; Preference establishes the difference needed for an alternative to be considered superior; and Veto acts as a restrictive factor, preventing overranking if there is an extreme difference.
AnalyzeForm.scenariosDesc: Choose the strategy to classify alternatives into categories. The Optimistic scenario tends to classify alternatives more favorably (highest possible class), while the Pessimistic scenario adopts a more conservative posture, classifying them only where there is consistent performance.
AnalyzeForm.analysisLevelDesc: The level at which cities will be compared.
AnalyzeForm.interestAreaDesc: Define the geographic scope, where the analysis will be applied.
AnalyzeForm.interestAreaValueDesc: The exact item within the area.
